STATION RANKINGS

Station leaderboard

Show cells as
How to read these rankings

Rank 1 is the best result for the selected metric. Equal values share a rank; the following rank skips those tied places. Ranks compare stations in the current customer, region and dashboard scope. Station search only hides rows; it does not recalculate ranks.

Arrows show movement from the previous available period. A dash means no comparable result. Blue bars and cell shading show relative rank, not achievement against a KPI target. Delivered volume includes all delivered shipments; the chosen metric may have fewer eligible shipments. Period history shows up to 12 periods ending at the focus period.

Performance metrics with an exception list open the shipments that failed that measure. Other metrics open the station’s delivered shipments. Data may represent a partial period, so compare shipment volumes as well as ranks.

Delivery performance settings

DEA is held to the original appointment date (the original EDD where there was no appointment), and DSP to the window of the most recently scheduled appointment, plus or minus the tolerance below. Both leave out the exclusions listed in the KPI dictionary. The origin dwell threshold also decides fault attribution (see Network fault below). All three defaults work untouched — this is here for when you want to override them.

Shipments left out of the report

Paste PRO numbers to take them out of the report: they are left out of every count, KPI, list, map and export, the same way STATUS_CODE XXX shipments are. One per line, or separated by commas or spaces. The list is saved in this browser and carried into replica exports.

Key customers

Pick the customers the network needs to watch. They get their own Live table on the Overview, under the map, with the same columns as Live > By Customer. The list is saved in this browser and carried into replica exports.

KPI dictionary and targets

Every KPI in this dashboard is defined once, here. The target and warn columns are the only thing that colours a number anywhere in the build — cards, tables, rank tiers and the linehaul Pass/Fail column all read this table, so a threshold changed here changes every surface at once. The values shipped below are the ones the previous build had hardcoded in four separate places; they are not operator-confirmed. Blank a target to switch that KPI back to plain uncoloured numbers.

KPIFormulaDenominator Date basisScopeShown on TargetWarn

Station zones

Scans are stamped in the local time of the station where they happened, so linehaul and total cycle are converted before subtraction. Every other leg sits inside one station and is unaffected. A starter table ships with this file; paste the region file to replace it. Format is STATION,IANA_ZONE, one pair per line.

Code with no zoneRows

Station regions

Used by Performance → All-time → Regions and the region breakdown on the stage views. The destination station is looked up here. This build ships the operator's real region file (159 stations), not a guess. Format is STATION,REGION, one pair per line.

Main and agent stations are kept separate from region. Region here is geography only — an agent station in Georgia is still Southeast. To look at one side of the network, use the Station type filter on Performance, Live and Shipments, or group by Station type on All-time. Main vs agent is read per shipment from IS_AGENT_MARKET, which is consistent for every destination station in the samples checked so far.
